units.raw_text: Implemented the LDPC decoder offload pipeline on the Marlowe 5K baseband card. Hand-tuned the layered min-sum decoder kernel against the FlexNIC FPGA, hit the 14 Gbps peak decode budget for a 100 MHz NR carrier, and reduced PUSCH BLER by 0.6 dB at the 10% target operating point versus the prior fixed-point implementation.
